findings.title: Unrequested company-name overline copy
findings.detail: Spec step 2 only calls for metadata title, a Kontak heading and ContactForm; the variant='overline' company-name eyebrow is copy the spec never asked for (OQ-FL-1 on final copy still open).

findings.title: Unrequested intro paragraph
findings.detail: "Isi form di bawah ini... Semua field wajib diisi." is visitor-facing copy not in the Implementation steps or PRD.

findings.title: Unrequested metadata.description
findings.detail: Spec step 2 specifies only metadata title Kontak; a description was added.

findings.title: the "plain text, never HTML" test can never fail
findings.detail: Typing into a controlled input can never produce a element; the only server-controlled text outside an input is {error.message} at index.tsx:60. Delete the test or point it at a 400 whose message is 'x'.

findings.title: Untested branch: onInvalid clears the stale banner
findings.detail: No test submits invalid data after a finished mutation; resetMutation() on invalid submit is uncovered.

findings.title: Untested behavior: form resets after success
findings.detail: The success test checks the alert and request body but not that resetForm(contactMessageDefaults) ran.

findings.title: Page-level assertions and cross-module import added to ContactForm's test folder
findings.detail: The describe('kontak page') block (lines 14, 175-187) imports @/app/(blank-layout-pages)/kontak/page and asserts page metadata/heading from inside ContactForm/index.test.tsx; CLAUDE.md scopes a test folder to its own module and no sibling tests an app-router page. Move or drop the page-level assertions.

findings.title: Page inlines markup instead of delegating to a View component
findings.detail: login/beranda/tentang-kami page.tsx are thin wrappers rendering a @views component; kontak/page.tsx inlines the Card/Typography layout (the unit's target_files omitted a View file — spec-scoping note).

findings.title: Decorative send icon omits aria-hidden
findings.detail: HomeView/index.tsx:60 sets aria-hidden='true' on its decorative icon; tabler-send does not.

findings.title: Kontak page is a lone centered card, not a composed page
findings.detail: main uses items-center justify-center to centre a single Card (lines 35-55), the design slice's named "single centered card" failure mode; sibling pages (HomeView/index.tsx:39-90, AboutView/index.tsx:30-95) use a top-down Container with header block and a back-navigation link. Fix: same page shell as the siblings (top-aligned main/Container, header landmark, Beranda back link).

findings.title: Intro block is a bare div, not a header landmark
findings.detail: Siblings wrap the overline/h1/intro block in <header> (AboutView/index.tsx:33-41).
